about: Expected results of tests/workers/scenarios.mjs for the PATCHED rebrowser-playwright-core. Unpatched upstream must pass every scenario (else the run is reported as broken). A scenario listed in allowFail may fail; any other failure is a new regression and fails the run. Add an entry only with a reason and an issue link; never to hide a regression.
evidence: Measured on Chrome 155: the rebrowser-playwright-core 1.64.0 port (2026-10-08) and the 1.64.1 build (2026-10-16) both gave default 21/22 and alwaysIsolated 20/22; unpatched playwright-core 1.64.x and 1.52.0 passed 22/22. (The shipped 1.52.0 build failed setContent and concurrent-evaluates in default mode and 14 scenarios in alwaysIsolated mode; the port fixed both.)

allowFail.reason: page.exposeFunction() bindings are not callable from the page without Runtime.enable; passes with the patch off (mode 0)
alwaysIsolated runs every evaluate() in an isolated world, so page JS globals (window.pageVar) are invisible; documented mode semantics
